prompt_en: A cinematic adventure photograph of an unmistakably adult East Asian woman treasure hunter, age 23, actively climbing a steep sunlit limestone cliff above a vast jungle valley. Preserve the reference image’s delicate oval face, large warm-brown eyes, pale skin, straight ash-silver bangs, and long high twin ponytails. Her weathered expedition outfit combines a fitted navy climbing jacket with ivory shoulder panels, rugged khaki trousers, gloves, boots, a secure harness, and a compact leather map satchel. One hand clamps a narrow rock hold while the other reaches upward; her boots brace on separate ledges and a taut rope runs from her harness. Her expression is focused and determined, with a flicker of exhilaration. Compose an environmental action portrait: her full body dominates a vertical 4:5 frame while the immense drop, jungle canopy, and distant ruins establish height and discovery. Golden late-afternoon light skims the rock and rims her windswept ponytails; fine chalk dust catches the air. Dramatic side-low camera angle, 35mm lens, physically credible anatomy, realistic skin, tactile rock, crisp documentary detail.
